name: Verona Recreation Summer Playgrounds
description_short: Five week township playground camps for children turning 4 through grade 8, run at four Verona schools by age group: REC-LOT for pre-K and kindergarten, REC-PARK, Elementary Zone, and Junior and Summer Adventure, with crafts, games, sports and optional pool and field trips for older groups.
notes: Monday to Friday 8 am to 3 pm, closed Friday July 3. REC-LOT at Brookdale School (turning 4 by October 1, 2026, and entering kindergarten); REC-PARK at Laning School (entering grades 1 and 2); Elementary Zone at F.N. Brown School, 125 Grove Avenue (grades 3 and 4); Junior Adventure and Summer Adventure at H.B.W. Middle School, 600 Bloomfield Avenue (grades 5 to 8). Families send a nut free lunch and snack. Optional trips and walks to the Verona Community Pool cost extra for older groups. Registration opened March 30 on CommunityPass. The page does not say whether non-residents may enroll.
